title: SM AC10C
text: 离散时间或连续时间同步电机 AC10C 励磁系统，包括自动电压调节器和励磁机，输入 10 路、输出 1 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Initial field voltage, Efd0 (pu)} 指定初始输出电压、{Initial terminal voltage, Vt0 (pu)} 指定初始机端电压、{Initial terminal current, It0 (pu)} 指定初始机端电流、{Resistive component of load compensation, R_C (pu)} 指定补偿电阻、{Reactance component of load compensation, X_C (pu)} 指定补偿电抗、{Regulator input filter time constant, T_R (s)} 调节器时间常数、{Regulator gain, K_R (pu)} 调节器增益、{Voltage regulator denominator (lag) time constant 1, T_B1 (s)} 调节器滞后时间常数、{Voltage regulator numerator (lead) time constant 1, T_C1 (s)} 调节器超前时间常数、{Voltage regulator denominator (lag) time constant 2, T_B2 (s)} 调节器滞后时间常数、{Voltage regulator numerator (lead) time constant 2, T_C2 (s)} 调节器超前时间常数、{UEL regulator denominator (lag) time constant 1, T_UB1 (s)} 指定 UEL 调节器滞后时间常数、{UEL regulator numerator (lead) time constant 1, T_UC1 (s)} 指定 UEL 调节器超前时间常数、{UEL regulator denominator (lag) time constant 2, T_UB2 (s)} 指定 UEL 调节器滞后时间常数、{UEL regulator numerator (lead) time constant 2, T_UC2 (s)} 指定 UEL 调节器超前时间常数、{OEL regulator denominator (lag) time constant 1, T_OB1 (s)} 指定 OEL 调节器滞后时间常数、{OEL regulator numerator (lead) time constant 1, T_OC1 (s)} 指定 OEL 调节器超前时间常数、{OEL regulator denominator (lag) time constant 2, T_OB2 (s)} 指定 OEL 调节器滞后时间常数、{OEL regulator numerator (lead) time constant 2, T_OC2 (s)} 指定 OEL 调节器超前时间常数、{Maximum regulator output, V_Rmax (pu)} 调节器最大输出、{Minimum regulator output, V_Rmin (pu)} 调节器最小输出、{Maximum PSS regulator output, V_RSmax (pu)} 指定 PSS 调节器最大输出、{Minimum PSS regulator output, V_RSmin (pu)} 指定 PSS 调节器最小输出、{Exciter field current regulator measurement time constant, T_EXC (s)} 指定励磁机磁场电流调节器的测量时间常数、{Exciter field current regulator feedback gain, K_EXC (pu)} 指定励磁机磁场电流调节器的反馈增益、{Exciter field current regulator proportional gain, K_CR (pu)} 指定励磁机磁场电流调节器的比例增益、{Exciter field current regulator feedback selector SW_EXC} 指定励磁机磁场电流调节器反馈选择器 Position A: feedback from generator field、{Exciter field current regulator numerator (lead) time constant, T_F1 (s)} 指定励磁机磁场电流调节器中的超前时间常数、{Exciter field current regulator denominator (lag) time constant, T_F2 (s)} 指定励磁机磁场电流调节器中的滞后时间常数、{Exciter field current limiter feedback gain, K_VFE (pu)} 指定励磁机磁场电流限制器增益、{Exciter field current limiter proportional gain, K_LIM (pu)} 指定励磁机磁场电流比例增益、{Exciter field current limiter reference, V_FELIM (pu)} 指定励磁系统磁场电流限制器的参考值、{Alternate PSS input locations (V_S)} 指定 PSS 输入位置 Voltage error or after take-over、{Alternate OEL input locations (V_OEL)} 指定 OEL 输入位置 Take-over at voltage、{Alternate UEL input locations (V_UEL)} 指定 UEL 输入位置 Take-over at voltage、{Alternate SCL input locations (V_SCL)} 指定 SCL 输入位置 Take-over at voltage、{Exciter field proportional constant, K_E (pu)} 指定励磁机磁场增益、{Exciter field time constant, T_E (s)} 指定励磁机磁场时间常数、{Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C (pu)} 指定整流器负载系数、{Demagnetizing factor, function of exciter alternator reactances, K_D (pu)} 指定去磁系数、{Exciter output voltage for saturation factor S_E(E_1), E_1 (pu)} 指定第一饱和输出电压、{Exciter saturation factor at exciter output voltage E_1, S_E(E_1) (1)} 指定第一饱和查表电压、{Exciter output voltage for saturation factor S_E(E_2), E_2 (pu)} 指定第二饱和输出电压、{Exciter saturation factor at exciter output voltage E_2, S_E(E_2) (1)} 指定第二饱和查表电压、{Maximum exciter field current, V_FEmax (pu)} 指定励磁机上限、{Minimum exciter voltage output limit, V_Emin (pu)} 指定励磁机下限、{Potential circuit gain coefficient, K_P (pu)} 指定电势电路增益系数、{Potential circuit phase angle (degrees)} 指定电势电路相位角、{Potential circuit (current) gain coefficient, K_I (pu)} 指定电势电路电流增益系数、{Reactance associated with potential source, X_L (pu)} 指定与电势源相关的电抗、{Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C1 (pu)} 指定与换相电抗成正比的整流器负载系数、{Power source selector SW1} 指定电源选择器 Position B: power source independent of the terminal、{Maximum available exciter voltage, V_B1max (pu)} 指定最大可用励磁机磁场电压、{Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C2 (pu)} 指定与换相电抗成正比的整流器负载系数、{Additive potential circuit (current) gain coefficient, K_I2 (pu)} 指定附加电路电流增益系数、{Maximum available exciter voltage, V_B2max (pu)} 指定最大可用励磁机电压，按实例取值。
